taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Detached JWS payload bytes and signature-to-consumer agreement
controls.source_trace: Determine which exact bytes are authenticated and whether normalization/decoding makes the application act on different content than was verified.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate ordinary detached JWS from unencoded-payload b64=false; the latter requires correct b64/crit processing. Signature validity and identical byte digests do not ensure equivalent JSON meaning if duplicate members have first/last parser differences. Bind accepted algorithm/key and parse the verified bytes consistently, rejecting ambiguous structures where the application contract requires uniqueness.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local synthetic signed messages and harmless paired payloads differing at one transformation boundary; record verifier and consumer digests.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A valid signature on an unchanged intended payload is expected; a serialization rejection is not message substitution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind verification to the exact consumed representation and supported header policy, preserving legitimate detached payloads.
